scope: Coverage-only audit of Collatz and Riemann reader editions 1.1; no new API, conjecture closure or fresh formal build.

sources.title: Collatz: Exact descent, residue families, and the remaining global obstruction
Riemann: Heat growth, prime coherence, and the remaining cancellation estimate

mechanisms.summary: Exact positive odd acceleration and valuation of 3n+1.
boundaries: Only the accelerated odd map is a named API; each call is finite exact integer arithmetic.

mechanisms.summary: Accelerated, shortcut and classical word clocks: k, S and S+k.
boundaries: Word length/depth and the two-step clocks are tested; separate classical/shortcut orbit evaluators and the complete Appendix A table are not shipped.

mechanisms.summary: Owned valuation words, depths/offsets, exact rational affine maps and direct endpoint replay.
boundaries: Construction respects max_steps/max_depth; an affine value outside the realizing cylinder is not an actual orbit endpoint.

mechanisms.summary: Exact integer realization class modulo 2^(S+1), including the terminal parity bit.
boundaries: The extra terminal parity bit is mandatory; the empty word separately represents identity on positive odd integers.
A successful finite realization certificate does not establish eventual descent or convergence.

mechanisms.summary: Arithmetic cylinder density and the all-word relative odd density identity.
boundaries: No named density summation or infinite word partition API; finite cylinder density does not establish an independent random law along one orbit.

mechanisms.summary: Concatenation with offset 3^ell*C+2^S*D and exact realization.
boundaries: Applied to realizing sources, with construction limits inherited from the first word; rational affine composition alone does not certify admissibility.

mechanisms.summary: Strict original-source descent, coefficient gap, threshold and first descending cylinder member.
boundaries: Checks (2^S-3^k)*n>C, not merely coefficient contraction; source 165 and the terminal fixed point are tested.
uniform_descent_start concerns the endpoint of one fixed word, not a global or first-prefix descent theorem.

mechanisms.summary: Bounded exact first-descent search with prefix replay and explicit inconclusive records.
boundaries: Step exhaustion returns inconclusive with an invalid certificate; bit/depth resource violations raise ResourceLimitError.
Finite descent or initial seed one is certified; universal termination of search is not established.

mechanisms.summary: Source 27, first descent at odd time 37 and its complete termination table.
boundaries: Bounded search and supplied-word replay are available; shipped tests exercise descent from 27 but do not reproduce every Appendix A row or all complete clocks.

mechanisms.summary: Unit-valuation runs, compressed exits and the universal fixed-horizon obstruction.
boundaries: Supplied finite runs can be replayed; no named symbolic run/exit constructor or formal fixed-horizon obstruction is implemented.
The obstruction concerns finite lists of fixed-depth rules, not every finite adaptive algorithm.

mechanisms.summary: Family q_j=(2^(3^j)+1)/3^(j+1) with unbounded first-descent delay.
boundaries: Generic finite replay supports a supplied member; no named bounded family constructor or divisibility induction is shipped.
The j=2 progression control is not a test or proof of every family parameter.

mechanisms.summary: Progression lifts including 151+8192s to 1+54s.
boundaries: The declared word (1,1,10), cylinder and several large representatives are tested exactly.
No symbolic lift builder proves all base/slope hypotheses; descent does not establish termination of every lifted exit.

mechanisms.summary: Coarse odd-part progression rules and historical 1804/2048 residue coverage.
boundaries: The partial atlas, historical uniform rules and residual classes are not reconstructed by arithmetic.collatz.
Exact final-word realization is stricter than an odd-part upper bound; coverage is not a percentage of Collatz proved.

mechanisms.summary: Coefficient ratios, deficits, normalized offsets and noncrossing injectivity.
boundaries: Finite slope/depth/offset data are available; no named exact deficit or normalized-height API.
Finite observations cannot establish permanent noncrossing, infinite-orbit injectivity or the source-floor hypothesis.

mechanisms.summary: Cylinder capacities, geometric rarity and an infinite-orbit height envelope exclude eventually bounded deficit strips.
boundaries: No named packing/capacity or strip-exclusion implementation; the infinite-orbit proof remains source mathematics.
Unbounded deficit on every tail is not convergence to infinity and does not exclude the entire noncrossing branch.

mechanisms.summary: Same-word merger divisibility and the exact positive-cycle affine equation.
boundaries: Word multiplier, denominator and offset support evaluating supplied equations; no merger-search or cycle-exclusion API/tests.
Existence of a smaller realizing alternative and exclusion of every positive cycle remain separate obligations.

mechanisms.summary: Universal descent equivalence and open adaptive completeness.
boundaries: Global packet descent remains open; finite sound verification and bounded search do not supply universal certificate production.
Crossing with a positive offset and permanent noncrossing both remain global obligations.

mechanisms.summary: Frozen Lean closures, axiom audits and historical source counts.
boundaries: No fresh Lean execution, authentication of every receipt or certification of later manuscripts from earlier source counts is claimed.

mechanisms.summary: Completed zeta normalization, actual zero multiset and reflection/conjugation symmetry.
boundaries: Classical analytic source facts and third-party evaluators are not a named completed-zeta runtime API here.
analytic.positive_zero_string and analytic.reduced_zero_zeta address another special-function zero family, not Riemann zeros.

mechanisms.summary: Multiplicity-aware centered-zero heat packet and finite diagnostic truncations.
boundaries: No named evaluator accepts actual Riemann zeros, multiplicities, heat time and translation with a rigorous omitted-zero error contract.
Hypothetical shifted modes are diagnostics, not observed off-line zeros; t=0 is outside the positive heat domain.

mechanisms.summary: Normal convergence, heat equation, Laplace residues and the all-translation criterion.
boundaries: Finite zero lists or determinant tests cannot establish the all-translation criterion or authenticate all zero residues.
Meromorphic continuation, zero counting, multiplicities and compact positive-time domination remain analytic proof obligations.

mechanisms.summary: Normalized von Mangoldt Gaussian packet, archimedean/pole channels and exact explicit formula.
boundaries: No named prime-power heat-sum/digamma-integral API with a truncation enclosure or complete explicit-formula interface.
Prime powers and normalization constants/signs must be retained; a primes-only or finite unbounded-tail sum changes the object.

mechanisms.summary: L=1/4-d_u^2 removes the pole channel and retains nonzero rho*(1-rho) zero weights.
boundaries: Generic polynomial/differential facilities do not implement this normalized analytic heat-packet interface.
Transformed Gaussian factors have both signs; removing an unknown nontrivial zero mode destroys the preserved obstruction.

mechanisms.summary: Unit translation-band energy on a fixed positive heat strip and the universal subexponential bound.
boundaries: No continuum Bochner/Laplace or all-band energy certificate; finite quadrature is not the universal energy estimate.
Archimedean bounded-energy removal is analytic; the remaining transformed prime estimate stays open.

mechanisms.summary: Hermite polynomial factors for the scaled physical Gaussian basis.
boundaries: Exact finite polynomial constructors are present; normalized translated Gaussians, physical du Gram matrices and coherent projections are not.
dynamics.hermite uses standard Gaussian probability measure and must not be equated with translated physical L2(du) compression.

mechanisms.summary: Coherent coefficients, squared Poisson tail, shell cutoff and aggregate error.
boundaries: No named coherent coefficient/tail/shell-cutoff API or rigorous Poisson-tail enclosure.
The cutoff includes 0 through R; squared error and norm error differ by a square root. Stability does not bound retained arithmetic coefficients.

mechanisms.summary: Gaussian ground pairing gives K_s times the same field at heat time t+s.
boundaries: No actual-zero packet/ground-pairing API; infinite sum/integral interchange is not supplied by polynomial orthogonality tests.
Discarding the ground coefficient requires an independent exact recovery estimate.

mechanisms.summary: Exact integer Möbius sign and squarefree indicator mu(n)^2.
boundaries: Finite integer arithmetic tested through divisibility-poset inversion; no Möbius cancellation or asymptotic bound.

mechanisms.summary: w_K, signed c_K, finite reciprocal-zeta expression and direct-series truncation bound.
boundaries: No named c_K evaluator with a verified tail/stability contract or even-zeta coefficient interface.
The external classical RH equivalence is cited by the source, not reverified here; alternating sums can lose precision and a 1/N tail bound does not supply the asymptotic criterion.

mechanisms.summary: Signed divisor cubes and coprime-base regrouping.
boundaries: Finite sign primitives are reusable; the actual w_K cube/coprime regrouping are not named APIs or directly tested by generic transform regressions.
A finite truncation must preserve the bm cutoff; truncating every base at N does not give the original n<=N sum.

mechanisms.summary: Squarefree support, coprime inclusion/exclusion and interval counts.
boundaries: Möbius values expose support; no named interval counter or uniform dimension-dependent remainder estimator.
Nonsquarefree bases have zero contribution even when their cube value is nonzero; all-coprime counts overstate majorant support.

mechanisms.summary: Positive tails and the full absolute-majorant lower bound for d=o(log M).
boundaries: No runtime asymptotic support/barrier certificate; the written proof retains squarefree support and uses interval mass as a lower bound for the full majorant.
A lower bound on the triangle majorant is not a lower bound on signed c_K; dropping the cube-dimension hypothesis is unsupported.

mechanisms.summary: Exact prime high pass followed by reconstruction preserves a power mode.
boundaries: Historical HighpassReconstructionNoGo.lean is outside this Python module; a DSP high-pass filter is not the prime arithmetic operator.
Algebraic reciprocal cancellation does not estimate a prime sum or prove signed contraction.

mechanisms.summary: Neutral-vector preservation under diagonal filters and normalized scale changes.
boundaries: No named RH neutral-mode/no-go API; historical algebraic formalizations have separate declared hypotheses.
The obstruction concerns shared diagonal/neutral settings, not every arithmetic mixing mechanism.

mechanisms.summary: Haar sign symmetry on prime tori and the raw fourth-moment boundary.
boundaries: No generic Haar Lq/continuum moment theorem implementation; finite matrix or sequence norms do not establish these claims.
Global sign invariance does not imply local invariance; the fourth-moment bound does not make every signed collision term positive.

mechanisms.summary: Open signed rough-base estimate and equivalent universal heat-energy target.
boundaries: Closing estimates remain open and quantify over all scales with uniform constants; finite profiles or sampled positivity cannot replace them.
No new direct Möbius-to-von-Mangoldt transfer is asserted; stable compression and proposed detail-energy bounds do not close RH.

mechanisms.summary: Historical Lean checkpoints, finite compression experiments and source-count boundaries.
boundaries: Original computation/formal archives are not reconstructed here; the reader edition retains failed/unverified checkpoints.
Source counts are not independent-theorem counts or cumulative certification; no fresh Lean compilation.

audit.source_review: Full extracted reader texts, definitions, finite mechanisms, proof boundaries and appendices read.
implementation_review: Hermite polynomial constructors and finite Gaussian probability-sector boundaries
not_claimed: proof audit of every analytic theorem
